rotations.intro: A rotation suggests who serves each local week. It never overrides membership, blockouts or conflicts — those weeks are left open or filled fairly, as you choose.

policy.kept: Existing requests that are not declined are always kept; a proposal never removes or changes them.
policy.locks: Your locked choices are kept on every recompute. A lock that is no longer valid leaves the position open.
policy.eligibility: Only members of the exact team position are considered. Blockouts and overlapping commitments on other plans exclude a person; nobody is proposed twice on one plan.
policy.rotation: A team rotation suggests its person for that local week. If that person is not eligible, the rotation either leaves the position open or falls back to fairness, as configured.
policy.freshness: Availability freshness (never reviewed, or reviewed long ago) is shown but does not change the order.
policy.fairnessOrder: Fairness order: people without preference warnings first, then fewer plans served in the last {{days}} days (including earlier weeks of this proposal), then least recently served, then a fixed tie-break from the recorded seed.
policy.fairnessDisclaimer: Fairness describes this ordering policy; it does not guarantee equal outcomes.
